svg.aria-label: Start B3 + F4, end C4 + E4. The lower voice moves from B3 to C4, up 1 semitone. The upper voice moves from F4 to E4, down 1 semitone. The voices move toward each other: contrary motion, together. Diminished fifth (6 semitones) to major third (4 semitones).
svg.title: Contrary motion, together: B3 + F4 to C4 + E4

g.text: How to read this graphic: This is the closing
move of the four-stage path, drawn on the
keyboard. The dashed shapes are B3 and F4;
the arrows go toward each other and meet
around C4 and E4, where the major third
